svg.aria-label: SMART advisory console: the FAA's SMART AI air-traffic advisory system as a control-desk machine. Left, a tall data-intake drum is fed by five intake pipes carrying about 200 data streams — weather, flight plans, schedules, staffing. Centre, an AI recommendation press stamps route-suggestion cards onto a belt, with a gauge dial on its bridge and a queue drum of pending suggestions beside it. The press does not connect to the route board: between them sits the human approval lever, thrown up in lit orange, cabled to the press — a route only reaches the route-board drum on the right, and the output tray of approved cards, after a human pulls the lever. Verified numbers: 200 data streams, 180 flights rerouted, about 10 minutes saved, 22 centers, 0 decisions by machine.
svg.text: 200 streams · 180 reroutes · 22 centers · 0 decisions by machine
